# JavaScript reference

`pixelmatch.mjs` is the unmodified `index.js` from
[mapbox/pixelmatch b2800051](https://github.com/mapbox/pixelmatch/tree/b2800051f2b79d18cf27e51cd240cafd38cfb0ba),
retained under its ISC license for reproducible differential tests.

From the repository root, run `node tests/generate_parity.mjs` to regenerate
`tests/testdata/parity.txt`. The corpus covers both transparency backgrounds,
thresholds, output alpha, anti-aliasing, diff masks, alternate colors, sliding windows, identical
images, and structured and random pixels. Tests compare counts and every output
byte with this reference, with and without output and row padding.

PNG golden outputs are also generated by the pinned JavaScript reference, with the
C++ float threshold and alpha values. To regenerate them, install `pngjs@7.0.0` in
a separate working directory and run:

```sh
node tests/generate_golden.mjs /path/to/pngjs/lib/png.js
```

Only the fixture generators require Node.js. Normal C++ tests read checked-in expected data.
